hero.h1: Home Remodeling in Hagerstown, Done Right from the Start
hero.subheadline: LMG Remodeling is a family business that handles kitchen and bath remodels, drywall, paint, flooring and the smaller repairs on your list, at prices reviewers call very fair.

image.alt: Finished basement with smooth primed white walls, part of LMG's home remodeling in Hagerstown, MD

intro.h2: A family crew for jobs big and small
paragraphs: LMG Remodeling is a family business that takes on home remodeling in Hagerstown, from kitchen and bath remodels to a set of faded shutters. Its Facebook page puts it simply: professional work, reasonably priced and done perfect from the start.

Customers mention Armando by name. One family hung their own basement drywall and called LMG to finish it, and Armando's team did the corner bead, taping, mudding, sanding and priming until it looked perfect. Another homeowner had sun-faded shutters washed, repainted and rehung, more secure than before. Reviewers keep coming back to the same two things: clear communication and fair prices.

items.name: Kitchen and bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Kitchen and bathroom remodels are on the LMG services list, along with the tile, plumbing and electrical work they usually need. On one master bedroom and bath job, the crew started with prep, repairing badly damaged corners so the walls looked clean again.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a finished bathroom remodel in a brick Maryland townhouse: white subway tile shower with a clear glass door, navy blue vanity with a white top and brass fixtures, light gray porcelain floor tile, soft natural daylight from a small window, clean and uncluttered, warm cream walls; no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Illustration: remodeled bathroom with a white tiled shower, glass door and navy vanity

items.name: Drywall repair and finishing
items.blurb: From a single patch to a whole basement. When one family hung their own drywall and it came out less than perfect, LMG did the corner bead, taping, mudding, sanding and priming, and the reviewer says it ended up looking perfect.

image.alt: Basement room with finished, primed white drywall, a ceiling light and two small windows

items.name: Interior and exterior painting
items.blurb: Interior walls and ceilings, plus exterior doors, fascia, siding, window and door trim, handrails and concrete stain. LMG also takes down faded shutters, washes and repaints them, then reinstalls them so they look new again.

image.alt: Light blue laundry room with fresh paint, white six-panel doors and louvered closet doors

items.name: Flooring and tile
items.blurb: LMG installs LVP, vinyl, hardwood and carpet, and lays tile. Because the same crew also handles drywall and paint, a basement or spare room can go from bare walls to new floors without hiring a separate contractor for each trade.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a finished basement family room in a Maryland home with newly installed warm oak-look luxury vinyl plank flooring, smooth white painted walls and baseboards, two small basement windows letting in natural daylight, a simple navy sofa and a cream rug; no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Illustration: finished basement family room with oak-look vinyl plank flooring and white walls

items.name: Doors and windows
items.blurb: LMG replaces and installs doors and windows. On one call, the crew replaced a leaking window on the bottom floor of a three-level condo: they removed the rotten wood, replaced it and installed a waterproof membrane before closing it up.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a newly replaced white double-hung window with fresh white trim set in the red brick wall of a Maryland townhouse, navy shutters on each side, a new white six-panel front door nearby, clear afternoon daylight; no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names. Aspect ratio 4:3.
image.alt: Illustration: new white window with fresh trim in a red brick townhouse wall

items.name: Carpentry, repairs and power washing
items.blurb: Smaller jobs get the same care. Reviewers have hired LMG to replace a gable vent and the posts and rails on a split rail fence. The crew also power washes siding, foundations, walkways, porches, decks and patios.

image.alt: Brick townhouse with dark shutters that LMG washed, repainted and reinstalled

items.title: Licensed in Maryland
items.text: LMG Remodeling, LLC is licensed by the Maryland Home Improvement Commission under MHIC #05-152424. The number is printed right on the company logo, so you can check it before any work starts.

items.title: Prices reviewers call fair
items.text: Price comes up again and again in LMG's reviews. Customers call it very fair for the quality of work, a fair price for good results, and very fair on a small fence repair.

items.title: You always know what is happening
items.text: Customers say Armando communicated clearly, replied promptly and kept them informed throughout. One added that his suggestions improved the final result.

items.title: Respect for your home
items.text: One basement customer wrote that the crew was very considerate of their home and left it cleaner than they found it. Another described them as pleasant people with professional conduct.

about.text: LMG Remodeling, LLC is a family business based in Hagerstown, Maryland. In their own words, they do professional work, reasonably priced and done perfect from the start. Armando is the name customers mention most, for his clear communication and for suggestions that improved the final result. The company is licensed with the Maryland Home Improvement Commission under MHIC #05-152424. The work ranges from kitchen and bathroom remodels to drywall, paint, flooring, tile, doors and windows, along with smaller jobs like a gable vent or a split rail fence.

process.h2: How a project with LMG goes

steps.title: Reach out
steps.text: Call (240) 919-9294, email or send LMG a Facebook message with a few photos of what you need done, big or small.

steps.title: Talk it through
steps.text: Armando looks at the job and makes suggestions. One customer said those suggestions really improved the final result.

steps.title: Work with regular updates
steps.text: The crew does the work and keeps you informed. Reviewers describe prompt replies and clear communication from start to finish.

steps.title: Clean up and walkthrough
steps.text: When the work is done, the crew cleans up. One family said LMG left their home cleaner than they found it.

items.name: Christina B.
items.text:
I had a great experience with LMG Remodeling. Armando and his crew removed my shutters, which had become very faded from years of sun exposure. They carefully took them down, thoroughly washed them, repainted them, and reinstalled them. The shutters now look like new, and they’re actually more secure than they were originally.

Armando was excellent to work with throughout the entire process. He communicated clearly, worked quickly, and made suggestions that really improved the final result. On top of that, his pricing was very fair for the quality of work provided.

I would highly recommend LMG Remodeling to anyone who needs repairs or improvements done around their home. Professional, reliable, and great workmanship.

items.name: Kelly K.
items.text: LMG did a great job finishing the drywall in our basement! We had hung the drywall ourselves and it was less than perfect. Armando and his team did the corner bead, taping, mudding, sanding and priming and made it look perfect! Fair price, good communication and quality results. They were very considerate of our home and left it cleaner than they found it.

items.name: Cari T.
items.text: LMG remodeling replaced a gable vent, as well as fence posts and rails on my split rail fence. They were terrific to work with. Their communication was prompt and they kept me informed throughout. They are pleasant people and their conduct is professional. And their prices were very fair. They will certainly be my go to for projects at home

service_area.text: LMG Remodeling, LLC is based at 823 Woodland Way in Hagerstown, Maryland, and Hagerstown is the town named on its Facebook page. Kitchen and bath remodels, basements, painting and the smaller repairs on your list are all welcome, and so are quick fixes. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your address is covered, call (240) 919-9294 and ask before you book.

items.a: Yes. LMG Remodeling, LLC is licensed by the Maryland Home Improvement Commission, and its license number, MHIC #05-152424, is printed on the company logo. You are welcome to ask to see it when LMG comes out to look at your project.

items.q: Do you do kitchen and bathroom remodels?
items.a: Yes. Kitchen and bathroom remodels are on the LMG services list, together with tile, plumbing, electrical, flooring, drywall and paint, so one crew can handle most of the trades a remodel needs. One Facebook post shows the crew's prep work on a master bedroom and master bath.

items.q: Will you take on a small job?
items.a: Yes. Reviewers have hired LMG to replace a gable vent, repair a split rail fence and repaint and rehang faded shutters. The crew also does power washing, and a March 2026 post says LMG now offers junk removal and moving services too.

Yes, LMG offers free estimates. Call (240) 919-9294 or email lmgremodelingllc@gmail.com with a short description and a few photos of the job, and LMG will get back to you to set up a time to see the work in person.

Google lists LMG as open 24 hours Monday through Friday and closed on Saturday and Sunday. The fastest way to reach the crew is a phone call to (240) 919-9294 or a message on the LMG Facebook page, ideally with a photo of the job.

final_cta.h2: Got a project on your list?
final_cta.text: Call LMG Remodeling for a free estimate on your kitchen, bath, basement or repair.
